title: NBA: Matas Buzeli, Josh Minott fined for making obscene gestures

blocks.text: NEW YORK— Chicago Bulls forward Matas Buzelis and Brooklyn Nets forward Josh Minott have each been fined $25,000 by the NBA for making obscene gestures toward the stands during their respective games on Saturday. NBA executive vice president and head of basketball operations James Jones announced the fines on Monday. Buzelis’ incident occurred with 11:19 remaining in the fourth quarter of the Bulls’ 117-106 win at Minnesota. Minott’s gesture happened at the conclusion of the Nets’ 129-110 loss at Memphis....
